findings.description: Retrieved the single primary list (https://engineering.wayne.edu/electrical-computer/faculty, 45,329 bytes, sha256 7fada24c...c9e91) at 2026-11-25T02:24:00Z. Parsed 23 person entries (name, title, section); names match brief.people exactly, with no omissions in either direction.

The department faculty page publishes no adjunct, joint, affiliated/below-the-line, courtesy or research-faculty lists. The only list is the main faculty profiles listing. Those categories therefore produce no entries here, and no separate sections were found to apply to any person.
No profile pages were fetched: every brief profile_url points to the list page, and profile pages are optional under the audit instructions. Decisions rest on the list-page titles.
Excluded as teaching: 'Associate Professor (Teaching)'. Would change only if an official source showed a regular or joint EE/ECE professorial appointment, which the department page does not show.
